elements.description: A checklist with a progress bar.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading, and the progress bar's name

properties.name: steps
properties.description: The checklist. Each step's `done` flag is where it starts; when the flags change, the tracker follows them

properties.name: done
properties.description: Ids of the ticked steps; unset, the tracker keeps its own

properties.name: defaultDone
properties.description: Ids ticked at first when `done` is unset – defaults to the steps marked `done`

properties.name: autoPlay
properties.description: Ticks the open steps one after another, then starts over

properties.name: interval
properties.description: Pause between two automatic steps, in ms

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-done-change
events.description: A step was ticked or cleared (by a click or auto play); detail `{ done: string[], steps }` – the ticked ids and every step with its new `done` flag. Cancelable: preventDefault() leaves the ticks as they are (controlled use)

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, and the progress bar's name

props.name: steps
props.description: The checklist. Each step's `done` flag is where it starts; when the flags change, the tracker follows them

props.name: done
props.description: Ids of the ticked steps. Controlled when defined – pair it with `onDoneChange`

props.name: defaultDone
props.description: Ids ticked on mount when `done` isn't controlled – defaults to the steps marked `done`

props.name: onDoneChange
props.description: Called with the ticked ids whenever a step is ticked or cleared

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with every step and its new `done` flag whenever a step is ticked or cleared
